description: Core pg-tide operator dashboard. No-data is unknown, never healthy. See each panel for metric meaning, threshold source, and runbook.

panels.title: Pipeline health
panels.description:
Operator question: Which configured pipelines are unhealthy?
Metric meaning: pg_tide_relay_pipeline_healthy
Unit: none
Threshold source: alert rules
Runbook: operations/runbooks.md
Unknown/no-data: No data means unknown; do not treat it as healthy.

panels.title: Owned pipelines
panels.description:
Operator question: Does this relay own work?
Metric meaning: pg_tide_relay_owned_pipelines
Unit: short
Threshold source: alert rules
Runbook: operations/runbooks.md
Unknown/no-data: No data means unknown; do not treat it as healthy.

panels.title: Published messages
panels.description:
Operator question: Is delivery progressing?
Metric meaning: sum by (pipeline) (rate(pg_tide_relay_messages_published_total[5m]))
Unit: ops
Threshold source: alert rules
Runbook: operations/runbooks.md
